items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Well this boy's name, his brother, Thereto Pernell. Yeah he was one of my teachers also.

ctx.x: Alton Pernell. Well this boy's name, his brother, Thereto Pernell. Yeah he was one of my teachers also. He taught me quite a bit because he had played much longer than I had and I used to go to his house for lessons. But he had a stroke about two years ago, I said two or three of them since that time.
